summary.text: HAGENESGRUPPEN AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1989-01-02. Hagenesgruppen AS is registered for renting, buying and selling property, retail trade and service activities. Its statutory purpose also includes importing and selling beverages, buying and selling shares, and participating in companies with the same or similar purposes. It was previously named HAGENES EIENDOM AS until 2020-01-30. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 279 717 NOK and the annual result was 1 011 225 NOK; operating income was down from 1 840 970 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -3 918 655 NOK in 2024 to 1 011 225 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 286 333 NOK in 2024 to 3 297 558 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-04 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
